config.doses: every step > 0 of each record's save_steps
config.item_id: sha256 of the UTF-8 of the stripped text, first 16 hex (freeze_splits.py)

headline.definition: THE D-344 COUNT (headline): the conversations with a user turn of Phase 1's trained text whose item_id (sha256 of the stripped turn, first 16 hex) differs from the item_id of the prompt Phase 1 checked (train_lora.text_and_prompt(row, format)[1]) and is an item of the file; the distinct items those turns are
headline.count_of: count of consumed examples (the first 16 x step examples); see bias.upper_bound_on_trained
headline.where: counts.<corpus>.doses.<step>.headline (union over data/frozen); by_frozen_file per split
headline.per_item: headline_items: each item the headline counts, its file(s), its text length in characters and its conversations per arm and dose
headline.short_items: counts.<corpus>.doses.<step>.headline_excluding_items_under_n_chars, N in [8, 16, 32]: a reading aid, not a rule; the headline is unchanged

headline_items.definition: every frozen item the headline counts in some arm (Phase 1 corpus) and dose, sorted by text length then item_id: its data/frozen file(s), its stripped text's length in characters (Python str length) and, per arm and dose, the conversations among the consumed examples of that dose (the first micro_bs x grad_accum x step) with a trained, unchecked user turn that is this item. A conversation can hold two items, so the items' counts do not sum to the headline

rules.trained_unchecked_user_turn: THE D-344 COUNT (headline): the conversations with a user turn of Phase 1's trained text whose item_id (sha256 of the stripped turn, first 16 hex) differs from the item_id of the prompt Phase 1 checked (train_lora.text_and_prompt(row, format)[1]) and is an item of the file; the distinct items those turns are
rules.later_user_turn_by_position: the same over the user turns after the first by position (differs from the headline where train_lora.first_human_turn and the marker split disagree)
rules.any_user_turn: the same over every user turn and the checked prompt itself
rules.assistant_turn: the same over the assistant turns (reported; not part of the D-344 rule)
rules.normalised_user_turn_bound: A BOUND, not the D-344 count: a user turn whose paraphrase_overlap.normalise text equals a frozen item's (non-empty; includes the exact matches). Incomparable with contained_user_turn_bound (a normalised match need not contain the item's stripped text): neither includes the other; their union, normalised_or_contained_user_turn_bound, is the widest user-turn column
rules.contained_user_turn_bound: A BOUND, not the D-344 count: a frozen item's stripped text is a substring of a user turn (includes the exact matches; very short frozen texts inflate it). Incomparable with normalised_user_turn_bound (a containing turn need not normalise to the item): neither includes the other; their union, normalised_or_contained_user_turn_bound, is the widest user-turn column
rules.normalised_or_contained_user_turn_bound: THE WIDEST USER-TURN COLUMN, not the D-344 count: the union of the two incomparable bounds, a user turn whose normalised text equals a frozen item's OR that contains a frozen item's stripped text (includes the exact matches; very short frozen texts inflate it); an upper bound on the headline and on later_user_turn_by_position; not on assistant_turn (it scans user turns only), nor on any_user_turn's checked prompt where that prompt lies outside every user turn; NOT a bound on paraphrases or near-duplicates, which no column here measures (D-108's MinHash Jaccard ran on the checked prompts, not on later turns)

bias.count_of: examples CONSUMED by the training loop up to each checkpoint (train_lora.py lines 217-227)
upper_bound_on_trained: Phase 1 truncated each training text (BOS + text + EOS) to its first 256 Mistral-7B-v0.1 tokens (train_lora.py lines 228-230): a matched turn beyond token 256 was consumed but not trained on; this module does not tokenize (the v0.1 tokenizer is not read); each match's char_start and char_end in the trained text are listed so a tokenized recount needs no re-run
a micro-batch with a non-finite loss contributed no gradient (lines 236-238); each record's nonfinite_microbatch_losses is stated
GradScaler skips the optimiser update of a step whose scaled gradients hold inf or NaN (scaler.step, line 243): those examples were consumed without an update; Phase 1 recorded no count of such steps
lower_bound_on_paraphrase: the headline is an exact match on the stripped turn text: paraphrases and edited copies are not caught (D-080); normalised_user_turn_bound and contained_user_turn_bound are incomparable (neither includes the other); their union, normalised_or_contained_user_turn_bound, is the widest user-turn column, an upper bound on the headline and on later_user_turn_by_position (not on assistant_turn, which it does not scan, nor on any_user_turn's checked prompt where that prompt lies outside every user turn), NOT a bound on paraphrases or near-duplicates: no column here measures those (D-108's MinHash Jaccard ran on the checked prompts, not on later turns); a later turn that is a near-duplicate of a frozen item without matching it exactly, normalised or as a substring, is in no column
bias.scope: only data/frozen (Phase 1's FROZEN, which holds the splits 4a reads); data/frozen_p2 is not counted

reading: per-file counts overlap across datasets: an item_id can be in an Aegis file and a WildGuardMix file; totals are union_of_frozen_files, never a sum over by_frozen_file
doses are prefixes: what step 25 has seen, step 100 and step 400 have seen too
matches: position is the index in the consumed order (seen by step k when position < k x micro_bs x grad_accum)
